kubevirt_api_url.description: The base URL of the OpenShift/Kubernetes API server (e.g., 'https://api.example.com:6443')

kubevirt_token.description: Bearer token for authenticating to the KubeVirt API. Leave empty to use kubeconfig instead.

kubevirt_kubeconfig.description: Path to a kubeconfig file (e.g., '/var/lib/fence/kubevirt.kubeconfig') for authentication. Ignored if token is provided.

kubevirt_namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where target VMs reside. Used when listing or identifying VMs to fence.

kubevirt_insecure_skip_tls_verify.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for the API server (not recommended in production).

kubevirt_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for API responses before timing out.

kubevirt_vms.description: List of virtual machines to fence. Only required for multi-VM fencing modes (e.g., 'list' or 'on' for multiple targets).

name.description: Name of the virtual machine (VM) in the Kubernetes cluster.
